title: Extension of a local literal
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be natural numbers with $a\le K$, and let a literal on $r+a$ coordinates have coordinate $i$ and required sign $s$. Its lift to $r+K$ coordinates has coordinate given by the local prefix embedding of $i$ and required sign $s$.
caveat: The defining statement refers to `localPrefixEmbedding`, whose definition is not included, so its coordinate map cannot be described more explicitly.
